scope: one context, one subject, one unary extensional atom; no rules, imports, automatic P0 migration, clinical writes or base conversion
time: strict UTC second timestamps; as_of controls record and human confirmation visibility; target_at selects explicitly asserted half-open bounded validity; no inferred persistence or prediction

validity.bounded: required start < end; start <= target_at < end
validity.open_end: recognized but unsupported_profile; never filled as forever

revision: revises targets same atom/context, strictly earlier records and containing bounded intervals; all applicable eligible revision edges mask their targets even when the reviser is masked; target confirmation is not required
eligibility: confirmed certainty AND at least one visible human confirmed review; review recorded_at >= assertion recorded_at
stops: unknown capability on ANY visible record takes precedence over unknown/unspecified eligible validity; pending, masked and out-of-period records cannot hide unknown capabilities; structural validation is independent of budget
answers: unassessed rows have null literal state, adoption sets and evidence; finished rows retain visible human review and revision-edge evidence; never certify or add clinical assertions
steps: 1 request start + sum_view(N_assertions + N_reviews + sum_query(2 + N_visible + N_eligible_revision_edges)); prepay scans, then commit each row; shared budget; sorted IDs; no cache discounts
limitations: unknown/unspecified validity cannot be refined through a revision in this fragment; no persistent identity store or interval clinical validity guarantee
